# Student guide

For students who receive certificates through Certyfi: how to sign in, pay
when needed, and view and share your certificates.

## Your Certyfi account

### Set up your account

When your institution requests a certificate for you, Certyfi emails you
from **no-reply@ahamsys.com**. The first email has a button to **set up
your account**: choose a password and you're in. Can't find it? Look in
your spam folder.

### Sign in

1. Open **Student login** on Certyfi's home page.
2. Enter your email and password. You don't need an institution code:
   Certyfi finds your institution.
3. Studied at more than one institution using Certyfi? You'll be asked which
   one to open. Each institution has its own password.

![The student sign-in page](/assets/help/img/student-login.png)

### Forgot your password

On the sign-in page choose **Forgot your password?** and enter your email.
Certyfi emails you a link to choose a new password; it works for one hour.

## Your certificates

### See your certificates

After signing in you see every certificate your institution has issued or
requested for you, with its status:

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **Awaiting payment** | Pay for it to continue (below) |
| **Waiting for approval** | Your institution is reviewing it |
| **Issued** | Ready to view, download and share |
| **Not issued** | Rejected or cancelled; your email from Certyfi says why |

Search by title, code or any detail on the certificate (roll number,
grade, course), and filter by status or year.

![Your certificates in the student portal](/assets/help/img/student-portal.png)

### Pay for a certificate

If a certificate shows **Awaiting payment**, choose **Pay now**. Pay before
the date shown: an unpaid request is cancelled after it, and you'll get a
reminder email a few days before. Once paid, it goes for approval (or is
issued at once) and you're emailed when it's ready.

### View, download and share

Choose **View certificate** to open its public page. From there you can
**Download PDF**, **Add to LinkedIn**, download the **digital credential**
(an Open Badges file for badge wallets), or show its **QR code**. Anyone you
send the link to can check it's genuine, without an account.

## Questions

**I didn't get an email from Certyfi.**
Check your spam folder for no-reply@ahamsys.com. Still nothing? Ask your
institution to send your link again.

**My name is spelled wrong on a certificate.**
Contact your institution: they correct it by issuing a new certificate.

**A certificate shows "Awaiting payment" but I've paid.**
Refresh the page. If it stays, contact your institution.
